description: React component for a channel invite modal in Mattermost, allowing users to search, select, and invite users or groups to a channel with support for access control, pagination, and custom rendering.

classes.name: ChannelInviteModalComponent
classes.description: React functional component for managing the UI and logic of inviting users and groups to a Mattermost channel, including search, selection, pagination, and access control features.

methods.name: isUser
methods.description: Type guard to check if an option is a UserProfileValue.

methods.name: formatAttributeName
methods.description: Formats attribute names for display in tooltips.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a user or group to the selected list, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: onHide
methods.description: Handles modal hide event, resets user statuses.

methods.name: handleInviteError
methods.description: Handles errors during the invite process.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Removes selected users/groups from the selection.

methods.name: setUsersLoadingState
methods.description: Sets the loading state for user fetch operations.

methods.name: fetchAbacUsers
methods.description: Fetches users for ABAC channels without polluting Redux store.

methods.name: handlePageChange
methods.description: Handles pagination with cursor-based fetching for users.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits the selected users/groups to be added to the channel.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs search for users and groups with debounce.

methods.name: renderOption
methods.description: Renders individual options (users or groups) in the multiselect.
